sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact locally owned8-worker executor is acquired before try. All exits execute finallyshutdownNow and boundedawaitTermination10s with failing assertion;64 Futures each join5s. No ignored resource owner; implicit executorclose can wait unbounded.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact site is whole stateless pure-data JUnit Test, not a managed J2EE webapp.8 owned workers run64 fixed byte-vector assertions, eachFuture5s, finallyshutdownNow/await10s proves finite resource termination; no DB/driver/native/FS/Root/Unit/SQL execution.
